title: Factors contributing to preventing operating room "never events": a machine learning analysis.
summary: A field-specific patient-safety result quantifies factors associated with actual never events; ML role and observed-data validation explicit. Association and modest event sample bound the claim.
ai_technology: 9,234 safety-standard observations and 101 actual root-cause analyses of major operating-room never events; three RF models, AUC 0.81–0.85, identify department-specific factors and associations with event probability. Retrospective case/root-cause data; findings are associations and do not establish causal prevention effects.
